messages.subject: logout hidden by navbar
parts:
Hi,
I use Shiny Server Pro. I just implemented user authentication, but I have a problem.

In one app that uses shinydashboard I can see normally the "logged in as.." and Logout button, but in another one (no shinydashboard, it has a navbarPage) the navbar covers the user info, and I cannot logout unless I append to the url the __logout__ suffix.
Looking at the page with Chrome's Developer tools I see that it's there,

<div class="shiny-server-account">  Logged in as <span class="shiny-server-username">user1</span>  <a href="__logout__">Logout</a></div>

it's simply not visible.
What am I doing wrong?

Thanks,

Marco
